title: Video Ad Hook: You Get About 3 Seconds to Stop the Scroll
description:
A video ad hook gets about 3 seconds to stop the scroll, so open with the problem, the result or a surprise.
Follow MarketOpsTips for a quick marketing tip every morning.

#marketing #videoads #shorts

beats.say: Your video ad gets about three seconds to stop the scroll.
So don't open with your logo.
And don't start with 'Hi everyone'. Nobody waits for that.
Open with the problem your customer has.
Or the result they want. Or something they didn't expect.
Selling a cleaner? Show the before-and-after first, then explain.
Look at your last ad. What happens in the first three seconds?
